newsitem.title: USA: Nextel gains users, scraps roaming charges.
newsitem.headline: Nextel gains users, scraps roaming charges.

text.p: Nextel Communications Inc on Tuesday said its digital wireless subscribers numbered 300,300 at the end of 1996, up from 85,000 a year earlier. The company added 72,300 in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The company also formally launched its service as Nextel National Network, a nationwide digital wireless network that carries no roaming charges.
"The true power of the Nextel National Network is that every market is like the customer's home market," Chief Executive and Chairman Daniel Akerson said.
